title: Arrived factory sealed smelling of rotted meat and mildew. Three washes and smell is still there
text:
Arrived factory sealed smelling of rotted meat and mildew. Three washes and smell is still there. I love a fuzzy, soft, cozy throw and so do my dogs. This one is soft and the grey blue color is very soft and pretty. However, this arrived with a horrific stench right out of the package. It's hard to define exactly - a cross between old, spoiled meat and wet dog fur and mildew. The smell is so strong that my husband noticed it down the hall as I was opening the box. I'm not joking.

I have washed this three times now with scented Gain detergent and hot water and it STILL STINKS. It came from the factory smelling like rotten meat and mold and that scent will not come out. I am throwing the entire thing away and running a full sanitize cycle on my washing machine now. Just avoid.
